text:
maya: Quick heads up 1: the quickstart 'Examples' section has a bad relative link to /docs/examples/cli that 404s when clicked from the new site header.

maya: Repro steps: open /docs/get-started -> click 'Examples' -> browser goes to /docs/examples/cli -> 404.

leo: thanks, I saw that too this morning when testing the new nav. Might be a slug change after the examples refactor.

nina: I can pick this up. Plan: (1) find canonical examples page, (2) replace the relative link with absolute or use frontmatter alias, (3) run link check.

maya: The canonical page is /docs/examples/cli-v3 (migrated last quarter). If we add an alias in frontmatter on cli-v3 for /docs/examples/cli we should be safe.

leo: tiny note: pref PR should include a one-line changelog in the doc and a pointer to the examples owner in the frontmatter so future pings land.

nina: yep. I'll open a micro-PR with frontmatter alias + one-line note + run `yarn docs:build` locally. Will tag @leo for review.

docs-bot: Created issue #4812: "quickstart: broken Examples link -> add alias to examples/cli-v3" 1: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4812 :white_check_mark:

eng-oncall: If you merge during high-traffic hours, please @eng-oncall so we can watch for any site cache hiccups. Also suggest a manual search reindex after deploy so the old slug disappears from search.

nina: Good call. Targeting a quick PR and will ping here when it's merged.

leo: Quick CR ping: I can LGTM fast; will check staging link post-merge.

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone.
